blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Reviewed 2026-10-19 for the KMS Labs Ethereum ERC20 KAU, not the separate Kinesis-native asset. Official KMS terms identify 0x14dab79fd7b7b3f748d434812fd6a9aac460ea52 and section 11 reserves freezing, blacklisting, restriction, seizure and recovery without advance notice. Ethereum block 26224761 (2026-10-19T06:14:23Z) confirms ERC20F implementation 0x0f25045d15c163478bb67c56c5d9d602628f4f62, accessRegistry 0xbdac11e1b2bb8d61bdef18ece5d1bc88387ab458, and supply 1,640,000 KAU on the only registered deployment (100% material). Its verified ERC20F transfer paths consult the registry for sender and recipient; the registry resolves to DenyList 0x0d7d2f28ab186cd706878c9943221b001bcfc3d7. At the same pin, registry ACCESS_LIST_ADMIN_ROLE is held by 0x6eff1bb0073c9b00fb6e090a19f8ac201a4f9138, with DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE retained by 0xe584e152bed254a177351cea587aa44c2a83a8ae. Therefore current active token-level holder denial, not merely contractual rights or centralized reserves, establishes Yes. The ERC20 is backed by Kinesis-native KAU held by KMS Labs; no tracked parent is declared, and reserve look-through cannot lower the direct verdict.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: Ethereum KAU is an issuer/custody-based representation of native Kinesis KAU: KMS Labs issues ERC-20 claims against native-KAU reserves, and redemption is subject to KMS Labs terms and compliance onboarding. The reviewed materials do not identify a trustless bridge, lockbox, escrow, messaging protocol, peer, validator, or route-level conservation mechanism. The Ethereum representation's uncapped minter and role administrator are assessed here and are excluded from native Kinesis Mint Authority.

routes.reviewNote: Ethereum KAU is an 18-decimal KMS Labs ERC-20 claim on native KAU held in reserve, subject to KMS Labs terms and compliance onboarding. KMS Labs identifies native reserve wallet GAJ6XIVDKRHVMYF5ZUDDJCX755F25JXGIAWX4JO2OUHC4B2XHVTA6ERC, but this account is not a proved lockbox or automatic supply-conserving mint/burn path. The disclosed issuer-custody representation therefore requires an economic reserve/receipt/in-flight plan and is not independent-liability census eligible. The opaque-or-unknown tier and original control observation dates remain unchanged. R1 source review: Sol curation campaign 2026-10-09 (W4T05Infinifi).

controls.label: KAU Ethereum representation MINTER_ROLE EOA
controls.capDescription: ERC20F mint() has no numeric supply cap or per-minter allowance.

routeChecks.caps: The verified ERC20F source exposes mint(address,uint256) to MINTER_ROLE without an aggregate or per-call ceiling.

controls.evidence: At pinned Ethereum block 26095802, hasRole(MINTER_ROLE, 0x4b1f9e5b20e8b9949b3db4b3ef5887f49d69c8dd) returned true and eth_getCode for that controller returned 0x. The implementation slot remained 0x0f25045d15c163478bb67c56c5d9d602628f4f62. Its freshly fetched verified ERC20F source gates mint(address,uint256) with MINTER_ROLE and imposes no numeric supply cap or per-minter allowance. The historical deployment observation at block 23337251 is retained as history, not a new role census.

controls.label: KAU Ethereum representation DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE EOA
controls.capDescription: DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE can grant MINTER_ROLE and can self-grant UPGRADER_ROLE, which can replace mint-critical logic.

routeChecks.pausersAdminsUpgraders: DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE is the administrator of MINTER_ROLE, UPGRADER_ROLE, CONTRACT_ADMIN_ROLE, and PAUSER_ROLE. No timelock, Safe, or guard was found in front of the representation controls; the role replay also found PAUSER_ROLE held by one EOA.

controls.evidence: At pinned Ethereum block 26095802, hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, 0xe584e152bed254a177351cea587aa44c2a83a8ae) and hasRole(CONTRACT_ADMIN_ROLE, same address) returned true; its eth_getCode returned 0x. getRoleAdmin() for MINTER_ROLE, UPGRADER_ROLE, CONTRACT_ADMIN_ROLE and PAUSER_ROLE returned DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE. The correct EIP-1967 admin slot 0xb53127684a568b3173ae13b9f8a6016e243e63b6e8ee1178d6a717850b5d6103 was zero. Verified UUPS source permits UPGRADER_ROLE to replace implementation logic; the role administrator can grant that role. No protective timelock or multisig is evidenced for this EOA path.
